name: friction_log
description: Files the moment an agent worked around a problem instead of reporting it, and sweeps the open records into agent-ready, needs-human or blocked. A record naming a hard rule, a tool contract or a guarded module is needs-human whatever else it says, so a daily run hands a person only the decisions that are theirs.

metadata.standaloneReason: One deterministic record and one deterministic mark; a skill would restate the flags without adding a step.

what.description: What happened, in the words of the agent that hit it.

wanted.description: What the agent was trying to achieve when it hit the friction.

reproduce.description: The command or steps that bring the friction back.

cost.description: What it cost in time, tokens or retries.

investigation.description: What the agent already found out, so the next run does not repeat it.

decision.description: Set when the fix is a decision rather than a repair; the record is then needs-human.

files.description: Workspace-relative files the friction touches. A protected path or any *.tool.json makes the record needs-human.

id.description: Optional id; defaults to a slug of `what` plus the fingerprint.

dir.description: Folder for the records. Defaults to .runs/friction.

sweep.description: Mark every open record and write sweep.json and sweep.md beside them.

check.description: Sweep without writing, and exit 1 when any record is blocked.

selftest.description: Assert the validation, marking and identity rules with no filesystem writes.
